notes: Run each eval against its own copy of evals/files/home with HOME pointed at the copy and IMPROVE_SKILLS_STATE at an empty dir, so the helper reads only the synthetic sessions. Set the copied transcripts' mtime to a few days ago: the helper skips sessions modified in the last 10 minutes and, on a first run, those older than 14 days. Eval 7 setup: ln -s missing-target <home>/.claude/skills/gone-skill. The skill is user-invoked (disable-model-invocation), so with_skill runs read SKILL.md as their instructions and treat the prompt as what the user typed; the user is not present, so a run stops at the first approval question.

evals.expected_output: Usage for the four invocation forms, then stop
expectations: Output lists the no-argument, <skill-name>, --since and --session forms
No scan, excerpts or log command is run
No file under IMPROVE_SKILLS_STATE is created or changed

evals.expected_output: One proposal for demo-notes moving Breaking changes first, waiting for Apply / Edit / Skip
expectations: A proposal for demo-notes cites session 11111111 with grade explicit
The diff's old line is copied verbatim from demo-notes/SKILL.md ("Start with Highlights, then Fixes, then Breaking changes.")
The new text puts Breaking changes first
The proposal ends by asking Apply / Edit / Skip
demo-notes/SKILL.md is unchanged before the user answers

evals.expected_output: The CHANGELOG.md correction from one session is logged as pending, not proposed
expectations: The output-file lesson (CHANGELOG.md instead of NOTES.md) is not proposed as a diff
It is reported as pending with recurrence 1
decisions.jsonl gains a pending line for it with the full session id 55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555

evals.expected_output: No candidates: the only human message is a question about a quoted error
expectations: scan reports no explicit or correction signal for session 22222222
No proposal is made
The report says nothing needed changing

evals.expected_output: The plain-lists remark is attributed to inbox-sorter, not patched into demo-notes
expectations: The excerpt is graded correction, not explicit, and tagged [names: inbox-sorter]
No diff targets demo-notes/SKILL.md
The report notes the remark is about inbox-sorter

evals.expected_output: Only the exit-128 git error remains; it is discarded as an agent-composed command
expectations: excerpts shows exactly one tool_error for session 44444444, the Exit code 128 one
The passing test run (Exit code 1 ... OK) and the 'File has not been read yet' error are absent
No proposal is made; the error is logged as discard with an environment or agent-command reason

evals.expected_output: Stops early and reports the broken symlink
expectations: where gone-skill prints a broken-link line naming the missing target
The skill tells the user the install link is broken and runs no scan for it
Nothing is logged

evals.expected_output: Reports that no session matches and stops; nothing is logged
expectations: The reply says no session matches 9999
decisions.jsonl has no line mentioning 9999
Script check: log --sessions 99999999 exits with code 2 and writes nothing
